messages.message: ### Step 2: Direct Translation Translate each source line into Dutch, guided by the Reference Translation and Step 1 analysis. Output: ONE Dutch line per source line (preserve line count and end punctuation). Rules: - Follow the meaning from Reference Translation. - For "so X that Y": keep resultative structure, do NOT convert to "because". - No internal punctuation; copy only end punctuation from source.

### Step 3: Word Table & Coverage Check Build a word table from Step 2 translation, mapping each source word to its target equivalent. Output: ONE Markdown table (all lines combined). Columns: [Source Word] | [Contextual Definition] | [Target Word/Phrase] | [Back-Translation] | [Status: OK/MISSING/WRONG/GRAMMAR/UNNECESSARY] Mark GRAMMAR for agreement errors (gender, number, case) or other grammatical mistakes. Mark UNNECESSARY for elements present in source but not needed in target language (e.g., articles that target language omits naturally). After the table, list any MISSING, WRONG, GRAMMAR, or UNNECESSARY items.

**Word‑by‑Word Mapping Table (Source → Dutch)**
| Source Word | Contextual Definition | Target Word / Phrase | Back‑Translation (EN) | Status | |-------------|----------------------|----------------------|------------------------|--------| | **A** | preposition “to” (direction) | **A** | “to” | OK | | **le** | definite article “the” (plural) | – | – | **UNNECESSARY** (article omitted in Dutch) | | **quai** | relative pronoun “whom” (plural) | **hen** | “them / whom” | OK | | **poi** | adverb “thereafter” | **daarna** | “afterwards” | OK | | **se** | subordinating conjunction “if” | **als** | “if” | OK | | **tu** | personal pronoun “thou” (2 sg.) | **jij** | “you” | OK | | **vorrai** | future verb “wilt” (volition) | **wilt** | “will want” | OK | | **salire** | infinitive “ascend” | **opstijgen** | “to ascend” | OK | | **anima** | noun “soul” | **ziel** | “soul” | OK | | **fia** | future copula “shall be” | **zal** (auxiliary) | “shall” | OK | | **a** | preposition “for” (domain) | **voor** | “for” | OK | | **ciò** | demonstrative pronoun “that” | **dat** | “that” | OK | | **più** | comparative adverb “more” | **waardiger** (comparative adjective) | “more worthy” | OK | | **di** | preposition “than” (comparison) | **dan** | “than” | OK | | **me** | pronoun “I” (object) | **ik** | “I” | OK | | **degna** | adjective “worthy” | – | – | **UNNECESSARY** (already encoded in “waardiger”) | | **con** | preposition “with” | **met** | “with” | OK | | **lei** | pronoun “her” | **haar** | “her” | OK | | **ti** | pronoun “thee” (acc.) | **je** | “you” | OK | | **lascerò** | future verb “will leave” | **zal verlaten** | “will leave” | OK | | **nel** | contraction “in the / at the” (prep + article) | **bij** | “at” | OK | | **mio** | possessive adjective “my” | **mijn** | “my” | OK | | **partire** | infinitive “departure” (nominalised) | **vertrek** | “departure” | OK |

### Items Requiring Attention - **UNNECESSARY:** `le` (definite article), `degna` (adjective “worthy”) – both are naturally omitted in Dutch because the comparative form “waardiger” already conveys the meaning.
No **MISSING**, **WRONG**, or **GRAMMAR** issues were detected.

### Step 4: Correction & Final Output Fix any MISSING, WRONG, or GRAMMAR items from Step 3. Reorder within line if needed; do not add new content words. Verify that the output contains only Dutch script; no other language scripts should be mixed in. Output format (use nested bullet list, not table): - Line N: - Original: ... - Issue: ... (or "none") - Corrected: ... (or "no change") Output final Dutch text in ONE code block, line by line (no extra prose).

- **Line 121** - Original: A aan hen, als jij daarna wilt opstijgen, - Issue: **WRONG** – the preposition “A” was rendered literally as “A” and duplicated with “aan”. - Corrected: Aan hen, als jij daarna wilt opstijgen,
- **Line 122** - Original: zal een ziel waardiger zijn dan ik voor dat: - Issue: none - Corrected: no change
- **Line 123** - Original: met haar zal ik je verlaten bij mijn vertrek; - Issue: none - Corrected: no change
